basic_details.job_title: Presidency University Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Health Research (DHR), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India, sponsors a Start-up Grant Project, the TRANS-MAP study, at the Institute of Health Sciences, Presidency University, Kolkata. The Institute invites applications for a Project Fellow on a purely contractual post at Rs. 37,000 per month consolidated. The essential qualification is an M.Sc. in a listed life-science subject or a relevant subject, with a first class. Applications go by email to Dr. Rubia Mondal at [email protected] on or before 15 November 2026, 5:00 PM, and the interview is on 19 Novembe

qualification.details: M.Sc. in Human Physiology / Life Sciences / Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Molecular Biology / Computational Biology or relevant subject from a recognized University with a first class. Preference is given to candidates qualified in CSIR-UGC NET (JRF/LS), ICMR-JRF, or equivalent national eligibility tests.

how_to_apply: Prepare an updated CV, a brief cover letter and self-attested copies of academic certificates/mark sheets.
Send them by email to Dr. Rubia Mondal at [email protected] on or before 15 November 2026, 5:00 PM.
Write the subject line strictly as: 'Application for Project Fellow - DHR TRANS-MAP Study'.
Wait for the email from the Institute: shortlisted candidates are notified by email for the interview.
With the email: updated CV, brief cover letter, self-attested copies of academic certificates/mark sheets.
At the interview: two sets of self-attested hard copies of the application, full CV, mark sheets and certificates, and original identity/qualification proof for verification.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The email subject line must be exactly as given in the notice. Only shortlisted candidates are called for the interview, and they are told by email. The post is purely contractual, co-terminus with the project, and engagement is initially for one year. Questions about the post can go to Dr. Rubia Mondal, Principal Investigator, at [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About Presidency University Project Fellow Post
content_sections.text: The Institute of Health Sciences is part of Presidency University, Kolkata, and its notice gives the New Town Campus, Action Area-ID, Kolkata – 700156 as its address. The post sits in a DHR Start-up Grant Project, sanction order ref. F. No. R.12020/09/2026-HR (Proposal ID: SUG-2026-1479-reg). The Principal Investigator is Dr. Rubia Mondal, Assistant Professor, Institute of Health Sciences.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: M.Sc. in Human Physiology / Life Sciences / Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Molecular Biology / Computational Biology or relevant subject from a recognized University with a first class. Preference is given to candidates qualified in CSIR-UGC NET (JRF/LS), ICMR-JRF, or equivalent national eligibility tests. Experience in Molecular Biology, Transcriptomics, RNA isolation, Quantitative PCR, Cell culture and Clinical sample handling. Experience in Computational Biology / R programming for biological data analysis. Strong written and oral communication skills in English. The notice does not print an experience requirement as essential. For any further eligibility detail, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position is purely contractual and co-terminus with the project. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances.

rows.details: As sanctioned under DHR Manpower Head for Year 1: Total ₹4,44,000/annum
Initially for a period of one year, extendable only till the duration of the project

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Presidency University Project Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare an updated CV, a brief cover letter and self-attested copies of academic certificates/mark sheets. Send them by email to Dr. Rubia Mondal at [email protected] on or before 15 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Write the subject line strictly as: 'Application for Project Fellow - DHR TRANS-MAP Study'. Wait for the email from the Institute: shortlisted candidates are notified by email for the interview. With the email: updated CV, brief cover letter, self-attested copies of academic certificates/mark sheets. At the interview: two sets of self-attested hard copies of the application, full CV, mark sheets and certificates, and original identity/qualification proof for verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates apply by email, and shortlisted candidates are notified by email for an interview. The notice does not describe how shortlisting is done or how the interview is scored. On the interview date, documents are produced for verification. The interview is at the Institute of Health Sciences, Presidency University (2nd Campus), Plot No. DG/02/02, Action Area-ID, New Town, Kolkata - 700156.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The email subject line must be exactly as given in the notice. Only shortlisted candidates are called for the interview, and they are told by email. The post is purely contractual, co-terminus with the project, and engagement is initially for one year. Questions about the post can go to Dr. Rubia Mondal, Principal Investigator, at [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Presidency University Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 November 2026, 5:00 PM, for applications sent by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: An M.Sc. in Human Physiology / Life Sciences / Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Molecular Biology / Computational Biology or relevant subject from a recognized University with a first class.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of the Project Fellow?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 37,000/- per month consolidated, sanctioned under the DHR Manpower Head for Year 1 at a total of ₹4,44,000 per annum.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for the Presidency University Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Email your updated CV, a brief cover letter and self-attested copies of academic certificates/mark sheets to Dr. Rubia Mondal at [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. What should the email subject line be?
faq.answer: The subject line must strictly be 'Application for Project Fellow - DHR TRANS-MAP Study'.

faq.question: Q6. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 19 November 2026 at the Institute of Health Sciences, Presidency University (2nd Campus), Plot No. DG/02/02, Action Area-ID, New Town, Kolkata - 700156. Shortlisted candidates are notified by email.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely contractual and co-terminus with the 3-year project. Staff are engaged initially for one year, extendable only till the duration of the project.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring two sets of self-attested hard copies of their application, full CV, mark sheets and certificates, plus original identity/qualification proof for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is NET qualification required?
faq.answer: It is not stated as compulsory. The notice gives preference to candidates qualified in CSIR-UGC NET (JRF/LS), ICMR-JRF, or equivalent national eligibility tests.
